title: Our Special Community: Big Question Opener

focusWords.kidDefinition: A group of people who live and share a place together.
examples: I know all the people in the small community of my village.
Our school community helps every child feel welcome.
focusWords.greekHint: Κοινότητα: κοινό σημαίνει μαζί, ομάδα ανθρώπων μαζί.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Very good, important, or different from everything else.
examples: Our school community is very special! We are all friends.
My grandmother made a special cake for my birthday.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Things that two or more people both have or like.
examples: Maya and Leo have a lot in common. They both love football.
What do you and your best friend have in common?
focusWords.greekHint: In common: κοινά στοιχεία, κάτι που έχουμε και οι δύο.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A small place with houses, shops, and people.
examples: They live in a small town on Lesbos, but they enjoy life there.
Our town has a library, a bakery, and a little park.
focusWords.greekHint: Town: μικρή πόλη, μικρότερη από μια μεγάλη πόλη.

focusWords.kidDefinition: An area on the edge of a town or city, where houses are.
examples: Harriet lives in a suburb of the town, quiet and green.
Many families in my suburb walk to school together.
focusWords.greekHint: Suburb: προάστιο, έξω από το κέντρο της πόλης.

focusWords.kidDefinition: The busy centre of a town or city, with shops.
examples: Let's go downtown to look at shops and spend some time at the mall.
Wendy and Alex went downtown together on Saturday.
focusWords.greekHint: Downtown: κέντρο της πόλης, εκεί που είναι τα μαγαζιά.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Land outside towns and cities, with fields and trees.
examples: We've got a small house in the countryside and we love it.
In the countryside, we can see fields, animals, and big skies.
focusWords.greekHint: Countryside: εξοχή, η ύπαιθρος έξω από την πόλη.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A place where people buy food, like fruit and vegetables.
examples: Dennis went to the market to buy some fruit and vegetables.
On Sunday morning, we walk to the market with my grandad.
focusWords.greekHint: Market: αγορά, εκεί που αγοράζεις φρούτα και λαχανικά.

lines.text: Hoo hoo! Hello, friends! I am Lingo, and I love my community.
Look at this busy street. Can you see the shops, a tree, and the people?
Maya lives in a quiet suburb. Leo lives downtown, near the big shops.
Today we ask a big question: What makes your community special?

question.text: What is your favourite place in your town?

prompt.text: Point to the word for a group of people who live and help each other in one place.

explain.text: A community is a group of people who share a place and help each other.

prompt.text: Listen and point to the word you hear: special.

explain.text: Special means very good or different from everything else.

prompt.text: We both like football, so we have a lot ____.

explain.text: Have something in common means you both share the same thing.

prompt.text: A town is a small place with houses, shops, and people.

explain.text: A town is a small place with houses, shops, and people.

prompt.text: Which word is the odd one out?

explain.text: Countryside is outside towns and cities; market, downtown, and town are all places where people live and shop.

prompt.text: The busy centre of a city, with shops, is the ____.

explain.text: Downtown is the busy centre of a town or city, where the shops are.

prompt.text: Point to the word for a place where people buy fruit and vegetables.

explain.text: A market is a place where you buy fresh food, like fruit and vegetables.

prompt.text: A suburb is the busy centre of a city.

explain.text: A suburb is an area on the edge of a town or city, away from the busy centre.

lines.text: Time to play memory! Match each word with its picture.
Say the word out loud as you turn over each card. Ready? Go!

prompt.text: Tell your partner about your community. Use the frames to help you.

frames: My town has a ___ and a ___.

model.text: I live in a small town. My town has a big market and a park. My friend and I have a lot in common, because we both love the countryside.

lines.text: Brilliant work, friends! You now know eight Big Question words.
Your community is special, and you can talk about it in English!
Next time, Maya and Leo will meet in a new story. See you soon!

exitTicket.text: Name one word from today that describes your community.
Finish the sentence: My community is special because ___.
